name: Sideloading and Android developer verification
plain: Android will require every installed app's developer to be verified starting 2026.
meaning: Apps from any source on certified devices must be tied to a verified developer. A one time advanced flow lets experienced users install unverified apps. ADB installs are exempt.

android.permission: None; developer verification in Play Console or Android Developer Console
android.prompt_ui: Install blocked unless developer verified or advanced flow completed (24 hour wait)
android.store_policy: Android policy; enforced from Sep 30 2026 in BR, ID, SG, TH
android.note: Applies to certified Android 7 or later; global in 2027; hobbyist and student accounts have lighter rules.

ios.permission: Distribution via App Store or authorised marketplace; notarization
ios.store_policy: Apple requires notarization for all iOS apps including marketplace apps in EU and Japan
ios.note: iOS has no sideloading path in most regions; personal developer signing expires after 7 days.

limits.headline: Can install apps from outside the store on Android, but the developer must be verified
limits.user_action: You try to install an app file, and Android checks who made it
can: Install from verified developers on certified Android phones
Go through the advanced flow to install from unverified ones
Get lighter rules for hobbyist and student accounts
cannot: Install from an unverified developer without the advanced flow
Skip the rule on certified Android 7 or newer phones; it goes global in 2027
Sideload on iPhone in most regions, where it is not possible
limits.differs: Android starts verification in 2026 and goes global in 2027. iPhone has no side loading in most regions; personal signing expires after 7 days.

story.what_it_is: Android will require every app's developer to be verified, with a slow advanced path for experts.

marketing.name: Android developer verification
marketing.pitch: Google says it will tie every installed app to a verified developer to fight malware, with an advanced flow for experts.

story.for_you: You try to install an app by file and it may be blocked unless the developer is verified. If you are advanced you can complete a one time process that includes a 24 hour wait.
story.for_makers: Makers must register even when they sell outside Google Play. Google says it stops scam apps, and critics fear it will shut out hobbyists and anonymous makers.

use_cases.example: Scam apps that copy a bank app lose their anonymous hiding place.
A hobby game maker must register to share its game by link.
Students and hobbyists get lighter rules and can still install their own builds by ADB.
A company registers once and installs private apps on staff phones.
Alternative stores must now list only apps from verified makers.
Malware that spreads by link becomes easier to trace.
Open source tool authors worry about the registration step.

story.android_note: Applies to certified Android 7 or later. Global in 2027.
story.ios_note: iOS has no sideloading in most places. A personal developer signing expires after 7 days.

technical_bounds: Only certified devices; open source devices unaffected
